description.narrative: (USAID Global Health (GH)): Funds will support the extending of capabilities of the USAID Malaria Vaccine Development Program (MVDP) towards its goal of demonstrating proof of concept of an advanced vaccine against malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum for use in control programs. The USAID MVDP has been successful in building strategic partnerships with some of the most capable malaria vaccine groups in the world. Through these partnerships, the program works toward vaccines that attack the parasite prior to liver infection, in the liver, and in the blood stream using both standard and innovative technologies to acquire key insights into how to overcome the parasite's evasion tactics.
